text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's partial rollback we hit a tokenization edge-case on quantized LLMs in eu-west. Requesting a short runtime pin for the quant model family while we stabilize. Proposing 4h starting now. @deploy-bot please apply.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Applying temporary runtime holdback (pin).
Pin: id=pin-1759954321-qt scope=runtime version=3.14.1 region=eu-west duration=4h owner=maria

raj: What telemetry should we watch to decide lift vs extend?

lina: Three signals: decode_error_rate (long seqs), KV-cache miss delta, and token-level latency tail. Also run the canary synthetic suite for hallucination/regression checks.

kevin: I'll run canaries in eu-central and us-east at ~10 rps, seq len=4096. Will post canary ids.

maria: Add automated fail if decode errors >0.5% over 5m.

kevin: Canary started: canary-1759954370 targets=[eu-central,us-east] suite=quant-regress-v2 threshold=0.5%

deploy-bot: Pin active. Inspect: `GET /api/pins/pin-1759954321-qt`

raj: Ops snippet for quick checks:
```bash
# runtime decode error rate (last 30m)
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/metrics?service=runtime&version=3.14.2&metric=decode_error_rate&window=30m" | jq '.value'
```

lina: Subscribed alert: runtime.quant.decode_error_rate >0.5% for 5m -> paging. Added KV-cache delta alert.

anika: Product: should we post a customer advisory?

maria: Yes — short advisory: temporary runtime pin in eu-west for quant models due to decoding regression; no user data exposure, mitigation in progress, ETA 4h. Ops note: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-21-quant-rollback

anika: Drafted and queued in #marketing-waiting-for-approval. Notified legal.

raj: I'll update central pinlist and runtime compatibility matrix: /docs/pinlist.md and /runbooks/runtime-compat.md

maria: We'll monitor canary and telemetry. If green we lift early with 30m notice; otherwise extend or start RCA. 15m cadence updates here. :thumbsup:

kevin: Canary 10m results:
- eu-central: decode_error_rate=0.12% latency_p95_delta=+4ms
- us-east: decode_error_rate=0.08% latency_p95_delta=+3ms
No red flags so far.

lina: KV-cache miss delta +0.9% (baseline 0.7%) — watching but below threshold.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pin auto-expires at 1759957920 unless extended. Use `POST /api/pins/pin-1759954321-qt/extend` to modify.

maria: Thanks all. Update in 15. :coffee:
